title: odontoloma tenuifolium
intro: Odontoloma tenuifolium, commonly known as the Toothache Tree, is a plant species native to tropical Africa. The Toothache Tree has been traditionally used for its medicinal properties, providing relief from toothache and gum inflammation due to its health benefits of reducing inflammation and pain. Its therapeutic actions include analgesic and anti-inflammatory effects, which are attributed to its bioactive constituents such as flavonoids and terpenoids. The bioactive constituents of the Toothache Tree, particularly the flavonoids and terpenoids, contribute to its analgesic, anti-inflammatory, and antimicrobial activities.
